ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider help-desk fraud chain: Entra MFA method added → commercial RMM dropped on the victim endpoint within hours
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Scattered Spider (UNC3944 / Octo Tempest / 0ktapus) intrusion chain where the actor social-engineers an IT help desk to register a new MFA method or reset the password on a high-value identity, signs in, and within hours pushes a legitimate commercial RMM (AnyDesk, Splashtop, ScreenConnect, Pulseway, Atera, FleetDeck, Action1, TacticalRMM, ZohoAssist, RustDesk) for persistent hands-on-keyboard access.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as mfa_change_time from datamodel=Change.Account_Management where (Account_Management.action=modified OR Account_Management.action=created) AND (Account_Management.changes{}.attribute IN ("StrongAuthenticationMethod","authenticationMethod","authenticationPhoneMethod","MicrosoftAuthenticatorAuthenticationMethod","securityInfo") OR Account_Management.signature IN ("User registered security info","Update user","Reset user password","Admin reset user password")) by Account_Management.user Account_Management.src_user Account_Management.src 
| rename Account_Management.* as * 
| eval target_user=lower(user) 
| join type=inner target_user [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as proc_time values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_name) as proc_name values(Processes.dest) as dest from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("AnyDesk.exe","SRService.exe","SRManager.exe","Splashtop-streamer.exe","SplashtopStreamer.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ConnectWiseControl.ClientService.exe","TeamViewer.exe","PulsewayAgent.exe","AteraAgent.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","chisel.exe","rustdesk.exe","Action1_agent.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","ZohoURS.exe","FleetDeck.Agent.exe","Syncro.Service.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*anydesk*","*splashtop*","*screenconnect*","*connectwisecontrol*","*pulseway*","*ateraagent*","*ngrok*","*cloudflared*","*fleetdeck*","*action1*","*rustdesk*","*zohours*","*tacticalrmm*")) by Processes.user Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name 
| rename Processes.* as * 
| eval target_user=lower(user)] 
| where proc_time >= mfa_change_time AND (proc_time - mfa_change_time) <= 21600 
| eval delay_min=round((proc_time-mfa_change_time)/60,1) 
| table mfa_change_time proc_time delay_min dest target_user src src_user proc_name cmdline parent_process_name 
| sort - mfa_change_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let CorrelationWindow = 6h;
let RmmTokens = dynamic(["anydesk","splashtop","streamer","screenconnect","connectwisecontrol","teamviewer","pulseway","tacticalrmm","ateraagent","ngrok","cloudflared","chisel","fleetdeck","action1","rustdesk","syncro","supremo","zohoassist","zohours","gotoassist","logmein","frpc"]);
let MfaChanges = union isfuzzy=true
  (IdentityDirectoryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType has_any ("User MFA","Password Reset","Strong authentication","Security info","registered security info")
    | project ChangeTime = Timestamp, TargetUpn = tolower(TargetAccountUpn), ActorUpn = tolower(AccountUpn), ChangeAction = ActionType, ChangeIP = IPAddress),
  (CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType has_any ("Update user","Reset user password","Admin reset user password","User registered security info","Update StsRefreshTokenValidFrom Timestamp","Disable Strong Authentication")
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(parse_json(tostring(ActivityObjects))[0].Name))
    | project ChangeTime = Timestamp, TargetUpn, ActorUpn = tolower(AccountDisplayName), ChangeAction = ActionType, ChangeIP = IPAddress);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$" and AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where FileName has_any (RmmTokens) or FolderPath has_any (RmmTokens) or ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTokens)
| extend UserUpn = tolower(AccountUpn)
| join kind=inner MfaChanges on $left.UserUpn == $right.TargetUpn
| where Timestamp between (ChangeTime .. ChangeTime + CorrelationWindow)
| extend DelayMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, ChangeTime)
| project ChangeTime, ProcessTimestamp = Timestamp, DelayMinutes, DeviceName, UserUpn, ChangeAction, ActorUpn, ChangeIP,
          RmmBinary = FileName, RmmPath = FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by ChangeTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let CorrelationWindow = 6h;
let RmmTokens = dynamic(["anydesk","splashtop","streamer","screenconnect","connectwisecontrol","teamviewer","pulseway","tacticalrmm","ateraagent","ngrok","cloudflared","chisel","fleetdeck","action1","rustdesk","syncro","supremo","zohoassist","zohours","gotoassist","logmein","frpc"]);
let MfaChanges = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OperationName has_any ("Update user","Reset user password","Admin reset user password","User registered security info","User started security info registration","Add authentication method","Update authentication method","Disable Strong Authentication")
    | mv-expand TargetResources
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName))
    | extend ActorIp = tostring(parse_json(tostring(InitiatedBy)).user.ipAddress), ActorUpn = tolower(tostring(parse_json(tostring(InitiatedBy)).user.userPrincipalName))
    | project ChangeTime = TimeGenerated, TargetUpn, ActorUpn, ActorIp, ChangeAction = OperationName
    | where isnotempty(TargetUpn);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ProcLower = tolower(NewProcessName), CmdLower = tolower(CommandLine)
| where ProcLower has_any (RmmTokens) or CmdLower has_any (RmmTokens)
| extend UserUpn = tolower(strcat(TargetUserName, "@", TargetDomainName))
| join kind=inner MfaChanges on $left.UserUpn == $right.TargetUpn
| where TimeGenerated between (ChangeTime .. ChangeTime + CorrelationWindow)
| extend DelayMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, ChangeTime)
| project ChangeTime, ProcessTimestamp = TimeGenerated, DelayMinutes, Computer, UserUpn, ChangeAction, ActorUpn, ActorIp,
          RmmBinary = NewProcessName, ProcessCommandLine = CommandLine, ParentImage = ParentProcessName
| order by ChangeTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider RMM stacking + tunneling: ≥2 distinct commercial remote-access or reverse-tunnel binaries on the same host within 24h
ucs.description: Hunts the Octo Tempest / UNC3944 habit of stacking multiple legitimate RMM tools (AnyDesk + Splashtop + ScreenConnect + Pulseway etc.) and reverse tunnels (ngrok, cloudflared, chisel, frpc) on the same victim endpoint as redundant persistence before ransomware (BlackCat / RansomHub / DragonForce) deployment. Catches the redundancy pattern Mandiant and Microsoft consistently call out as a Scattered Spider hallmark.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.user) as users from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("AnyDesk.exe","SRService.exe","Splashtop-streamer.exe","SplashtopStreamer.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ConnectWiseControl.ClientService.exe","TeamViewer.exe","PulsewayAgent.exe","AteraAgent.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","chisel.exe","rustdesk.exe","Action1_agent.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","ZohoURS.exe","FleetDeck.Agent.exe","Syncro.Service.exe","supremo.exe","GoToAssist.exe","frpc.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*anydesk*","*splashtop*","*screenconnect*","*connectwisecontrol*","*pulseway*","*ateraagent*","*ngrok*","*cloudflared*","*chisel*","*rustdesk*","*fleetdeck*","*action1*","*tacticalrmm*","*zohoassist*")) by Processes.dest Processes.process_name _time span=1d 
| rename Processes.* as * 
| eval rmm_kind=case(match(process_name,"(?i)anydesk|srservice"),"AnyDesk", match(process_name,"(?i)splashtop|streamer"),"Splashtop", match(process_name,"(?i)screenconnect|connectwisecontrol"),"ScreenConnect", match(process_name,"(?i)teamviewer"),"TeamViewer", match(process_name,"(?i)pulseway"),"Pulseway", match(process_name,"(?i)atera"),"Atera", match(process_name,"(?i)ngrok"),"ngrok", match(process_name,"(?i)cloudflared"),"Cloudflared", match(process_name,"(?i)chisel"),"Chisel", match(process_name,"(?i)rustdesk"),"RustDesk", match(process_name,"(?i)action1"),"Action1", match(process_name,"(?i)tacticalrmm"),"TacticalRMM", match(process_name,"(?i)zohours|zohoassist"),"ZohoAssist", match(process_name,"(?i)fleetdeck"),"FleetDeck", match(process_name,"(?i)syncro"),"Syncro", match(process_name,"(?i)frpc"),"FRP", true(),"Other") 
| stats min(first_seen) as first_seen max(last_seen) as last_seen dc(rmm_kind) as distinct_rmm_kinds values(rmm_kind) as rmm_tools values(cmdlines) as sample_cmds values(parents) as parent_procs values(users) as users by dest 
| where distinct_rmm_kinds >= 2 
| eval window_min=round((last_seen-first_seen)/60,1) 
| sort - distinct_rmm_kinds first_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 1d;
let RmmTokens = dynamic(["anydesk","splashtop","streamer","screenconnect","connectwisecontrol","teamviewer","pulseway","tacticalrmm","ateraagent","ngrok","cloudflared","chisel","fleetdeck","action1","rustdesk","syncro","supremo","zohoassist","zohours","gotoassist","frpc"]);
let RmmEvents = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$" and AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | where FileName has_any (RmmTokens) or FolderPath has_any (RmmTokens) or ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTokens)
    | extend RmmKind = case(
        FileName has "anydesk" or FolderPath has "anydesk" or FileName has "srservice", "AnyDesk",
        FileName has "splashtop" or FileName has "streamer" or FolderPath has "splashtop", "Splashtop",
        FileName has "screenconnect" or FileName has "connectwisecontrol", "ScreenConnect",
        FileName has "teamviewer", "TeamViewer",
        FileName has "pulseway", "Pulseway",
        FileName has "atera", "Atera",
        FileName has "ngrok", "ngrok",
        FileName has "cloudflared", "Cloudflared",
        FileName has "chisel", "Chisel",
        FileName has "rustdesk", "RustDesk",
        FileName has "action1", "Action1",
        FileName has "tacticalrmm", "TacticalRMM",
        FileName has "zohoassist" or FileName has "zohours", "ZohoAssist",
        FileName has "fleetdeck", "FleetDeck",
        FileName has "syncro", "Syncro",
        FileName has "supremo", "Supremo",
        FileName has "gotoassist", "GoToAssist",
        FileName has "frpc", "FRP",
        "Other");
RmmEvents
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            RmmTools = make_set(RmmKind),
            DistinctRmmKinds = dcount(RmmKind),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            ParentImages = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 8),
            Users = make_set(AccountName, 5)
  by DeviceName
| where DistinctRmmKinds >= 2
| extend WindowMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by DistinctRmmKinds desc, FirstSeen desc
